# 1 Chronicles 6 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 6 (81 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.10 — "served as priest" vs. "served in the temple"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "served as priest in the house" / **PNEUMA:** "the priest who served in the temple"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "who served as priest in the house that Solomon built" — preserves *kihen*.

---

## V.15 — Agency in exile
- **EMET:** "when-YHWH-exiled" / **LOGOS:** "when the LORD sent...into exile" / **PNEUMA:** "was taken away when the LORD sent..."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "went into exile when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile" — maintains YHWH as active agent.

---

## V.28 — "Vashni" vs. "Joel"
- **EMET:** "Vashni" (MT) / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "Joel" (LXX, 1 Sam 8:2)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Joel" — MT *Vashni* is likely a textual corruption; the corrected reading is adopted.

---

## V.31 — "resting" of the ark
- **EMET:** "the-resting of-the-ark" / **LOGOS:** "the ark came to rest" / **PNEUMA:** "the ark found its resting place"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "after the ark came to rest" — concise rendering of *menuach*.

---

## V.49 — "holy of holies" vs. "Most Holy Place"
- **EMET:** "holy-of-holies [qodesh ha-qodashim]" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "the Most Holy Place"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the Most Holy Place" — standard English rendering.

---
*— SOPHIA*
